game_title: Call Stack Tower – Lantern Square Defense
game_concept: A survival strategy set in Snowy Hold – Lantern Square, a lantern-lit square: the snow ranger must handle ice wolves while practicing functions. Core idea – Call Stack Tower: Trace nested function calls as stacked blocks and unwind them in order.
theme: Snowy Hold – Lantern Square: a lantern-lit square
core_gameplay_loop: In Lantern Square, repeat each round: Trace nested function calls as stacked blocks and unwind them in order. Each round, ice wolves strike the sleigh, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the stack_height value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the sleigh from ice wolves in Lantern Square: keep the stack_height meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 50-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: stack_height drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 50-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 3 (intro tier): Call Stack Tower
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
